description: A test method marked `[Fact]` that takes no parameters and always runs the same way.
A test method marked `[Theory]` that runs once per data row from `[InlineData]`, `[MemberData]` or `[ClassData]`, each row reported as its own test.
The three-phase layout of a test: build the objects, call the behavior once, then check the result.
An object created once for a test class through `IClassFixture<T>` and injected into its constructor, used for setup too expensive to repeat per test.
The unit of parallelism in xUnit: tests in one collection run sequentially, different collections run in parallel, and each class is its own collection by default.
The xUnit v3 entry point to the running test, whose `CancellationToken` should be passed to async calls so aborted or timed-out tests stop.
The newer of the two .NET test platforms, selectable for `dotnet test` in `global.json` from the .NET 10 SDK on, with VSTest as the default.
